reference.limits: - Government data; bids follow each agency's procedure. - Japanese government open data; API spec downloadable; no key noted on the page.

adapter.terms: 官公需情報ポータルサイト (中小企業庁) search API; use is subject to the portal's terms of use. Bids follow each agency's own procedure.

search_postings.note: GET /api/?Query=…&Count=…&CFT_Issue_Date=<60 days ago>/ (XML; guide §3). `query` is required in practice (Query is the one mandatory search string; AND/OR/ANDNOT operators allowed; a single kana character is rejected). Count is the maximum number of results (the API has no offset or page parameter, so page is not sent — ignore next_page); results are limited to notices dated in the last 60 days. posted_at is 公告日 (CftIssueDate), deadline 入札開始日 (TenderSubmissionDeadline, often absent); category (物品/工事/役務), prefecture, OpeningTendersEvent and Attachments are in raw. A malformed query answers <Results><Error>…</Error></Results> with no results (postings is then empty).

not_offered.me: Keyless API ('ユーザー ID などのパラメーター…現時点では、用意していません'); no account.
not_offered.get_posting: The API has search only (Query etc.); there is no lookup by Key.
not_offered.submit_bid: Bids follow each agency's own procedure (the notice at url); the portal only aggregates notices.
not_offered.list_messages: No messaging API; only the public feed is machine-readable.
not_offered.send_message: No messaging API; only the public feed is machine-readable.
not_offered.credits: Keyless API; no account or credits.
